recentItems.title: Persona 4 Revival – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
recentItems.description:
Persona 4 Revival goes on air May 20, 2027 on Nintendo Switch 2!

In Persona 4 Revival, legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journey to prevent more tragedies while uncovering the truth behind the chaos.
 
#NintendoDirect #Persona4Revival

recentItems.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX – Pre-order Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
recentItems.description:
Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX is coming February 16, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/yu-gi-oh-tag-force-gx-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.
 
Your final year at Duel Academy is officially underway! Strengthen your affinity with your classmates and build memories as you study the art of Tag Dueling and prepare for a Graduation Duel to remember. 

Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX marks the debut of Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 content in North and Latin America.
